file_stem: RWB E1 021 Transfer rules and engine v1
title: Transfer rules and engine v1
goal: Move cases between queues and teams by rule on eight triggers, or by hand with a reason
why: A case must follow its route (e.g. restructure to litigation) without e-mail. Legal hold freezes automated moves; every move is logged with its rule.
ace_note: No ACE read. Transfers act on Workbench case state and TRANSFER rule rows only.

writes.note: old one ended, new TRANSFER row + reason code

stores: Outbox: CaseTransferred (EV-04), CaseStateChanged (EV-05) for hold and release

functions.name: LegalHoldService
functions.does: place or lift a legal hold

rules: BR3: a manual transfer needs a reason code from LOV-TRANSFER-REASON
BR6: no automated transfer while the case is on legal hold (R-UNI-20)
BR8: the same event ID is processed once
BR10: a transfer keeps the case status and its clocks
risks: Two transfers at once -> version clash (MSG-GEN-004)
example: RW-2026-000301 is IN_PROGRESS in TDR-BKK-CO, owner U-21
Route R4 approved -> row TRF-007 (TRF-2026.11) moves it to LIT-BKK-OFF
New owner U-31 by lowest load; status and clocks unchanged
